summary: Iteration 19: tested the ChatGPT (openai gpt-6-sol) integration and the iteration 18 regression fixes. Backend pytest: 13/13 pass with live LLM calls. Tested: chat session CRUD, SSE streaming, persistence, multi-turn context, title from the first message, deletion and 404 isolation from other users; AI dossier check (Romanian, structured verdict/lipsuri/neconcordanțe/pași); draft (stream; 400 for an invalid module or empty label); /ai/extract on a generated PDF (engine 'ChatGPT (GPT 6 Sol)'; client_name, POD, address, county and operator all extracted correctly); gating (START/PRO get 402, ai_gpt disabled gives 403 for a FULL subscriber, platform admin unaffected, restored to []); regressions (an instalator team member now gets plan.disabled and is blocked; client PUT with stale docs keeps docs.semnate; PIF change invalidates the pif_pv signed upload and adds a missing note). Frontend: /asistent-ai chat streams, persists across reload and deletes; the prosumer edit form shows ai-check-section and its result streams; 'Redactează cu AI' -> generate -> apply fills the textarea; a START user sees the 'Este necesar abonamentul FULL' gate and no AI draft or check widgets. The sign-days input is now 80px inline. Total LLM calls: about 9.

issues: The model sometimes returns markdown bold (e.g. '**Necesită completări.**', '**maximum 4 Ω**') even though RULES asks for plain text. It is rendered raw with whitespace-pre-wrap, so literal asterisks show. Strip ** in the frontend or render minimal markdown.

action_items: LOW: strip or render markdown '**' in AI outputs (AiAssistant Bubble, AiDossierCheck, AiDraft result).
critical_code_review_comments: new_chat passes the system prompt both as system_message and as the first initial_messages entry. This may duplicate the system message (works, but wastes tokens). Verify that LlmChat does not prepend it again.

sse(): if the client disconnects mid-stream, on_done is never called, so the user message is persisted without an assistant reply. The next turn's history then has two consecutive user messages (acceptable).
ai_message history uses the last 30 messages without a token cap (each message up to 6000 chars), so it may get expensive on long sessions.
AiDraft's form payload sends the whole form, including large fields; the backend filters to scalars and truncates to 8000 chars. OK.
ai_extract falls back to Gemini when ai_gpt is unavailable (e.g. a PRO plan with ai_extract). Correct by design.
